title: Validated Deployment Gates: SSO, KMS, RBAC Operational Criteria
creator: Aisha Kaur
description:
Summary:
This ticket defines the operational acceptance criteria and sign-off checklist required for private/VPC deployments to be approved for customer onboarding. Scope covers SSO (SAML/OIDC), RBAC role matrix and enforcement, comprehensive audit logging for admin/operator actions, and customer key custody via KMS/HSM integrations. The goal is a deterministic checklist that cross-teams (Product, Security, Infra, Support) can use to validate readiness and document any scoped exceptions.

Goals:
- Provide a granular acceptance checklist that maps requirements to test artifacts and owners.
- Clarify scope changes from the original PRD: include explicit HSM interoperability tests and long-term audit retention policy (90 days baseline, 1 year optional).
- Reduce onboarding friction by surfacing required config templates, playbooks, and rollback criteria.

Scope (in):
- SSO: SAML 2.0 IdP integration tests, OIDC discovery validation, SCIM provisioning optional tests.
- RBAC: role definitions (Admin, Platform Operator, ReadOnly, AuditOperator), impersonation controls, least-privilege enforcement across Console and APIs.
- Audit Logging: ensure immutable logs for admin actions, customer access events, key operations; log retention and export to customer SIEM via syslog/forwarders.
- KMS/HSM: integration validation for CMEK and HSM-backed keys, key rotation procedures, emergency key revocation playbook.
- Operational playbooks: onboarding checklist, upgrade rollback steps, incident response for key compromise.

Out of scope (for this ticket):
- Implementation of new KMS providers beyond AWS KMS and AWS CloudHSM (future work).
- SCIM delta sync improvements (can be covered in separate follow-up).

Acceptance criteria (must be met before sign-off):
1) SSO:
  - Test matrix demonstrating successful SAML login and logout flows with at least two IdPs (Okta, Azure AD) and one OIDC provider. Attachments: SSO-test-results-2025-03-01.pdf.
  - Automated smoke tests in CI that run SAML auth and return consistent user attribute mappings.

2) RBAC:
  - Role matrix documented and published (Console + API) with examples for common operator tasks.
  - Enforcement verified: action-level denial verified for ReadOnly role across 25 representative API endpoints. Test report attached.
  - AuditOperator role able to access logs without data-modification privileges.

3) Audit Logging:
  - Admin operability events (create/delete/update deployment, key rotations, IAM changes) are recorded with timestamp, actor, IP, and request id.
  - Logs are tamper-evident: at least one proof-of-concept append-only export to S3 with object immutability flag and checksum.
  - Retention policy applied: baseline 90 days in primary account; customer export path validated.

4) KMS/HSM:
  - CMEK encryption test vectors show identical ciphertext semantics across rotation.
  - HSM integration smoke run: key import, sign/verify, and asymmetric ops tested on CloudHSM with sample workload.
  - Key rotation runbook validated with automated simulation, and timeline for rollback (<= 30 minutes) documented.

5) Operational readiness:
  - Onboarding playbook completed with step-by-step checklist and owner assignments.
  - Support runbook for key compromise and SSO outage with clear communication templates.
  - SLA gating: private deployments must meet baseline latency/availability gates during onboarding (see runtime-1.18).

Sign-off checklist (each item must be explicitly signed by the role listed):
- [Product Manager] Confirm acceptance criteria are complete and targeted for release. (signatory: Aisha Kaur)
- [Security Reviewer] Threat model review and approval of KMS/HSM plan. (signatory: Priya Menon)
- [Infra Lead] Confirmation of HSM network isolation and NACL/security group controls. (signatory: Marco Li)
- [SRE] Monitoring and alerting configured for audit log pipeline and key operations. (signatory: Tanya Brooks)
- [Compliance] Data retention and export controls align with SOC2/ISO requirements. (signatory: Elena Gruber)
- [Support/Oncall] Runbook validated and playbook rehearsed. (signatory: Daniel Park)

Testing plan and artifacts required for sign-off:
- CI test artifacts: sso-ci-smoke.log, rbac-ci-coverage.json, kms-rotation-sim.csv.
- Manual test results: hsm-interop-manual.md, audit-immutability-check.pdf.
- External security review artifact: pen-test-summary-2025-02.pdf (if required).

Scope change log (recorded decisions and trade-offs):
- 2025-02-15 by Aisha Kaur: Added HSM interoperability to acceptance scope after enterprise customer request; estimate increased from 5 to 8 points.
- 2025-02-21 by Marco Li: Agreed to baseline support for AWS CloudHSM only in initial release; other vendors deferred.
- 2025-02-28 by Priya Menon: Required immutable export proof-of-concept added to audit criteria.

Rollout gating and fallback policy:
- Canary: enable private deployment in a single region and run end-to-end auth + keyflow tests with internal customers for 72 hours.
- If critical audit logging or KMS operations fail during canary, automatically rollback to non-CMEK mode and pause new onboardings.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: HSM network misconfiguration could expose key material. Mitigation: strict VPC-only access & automated NACL verification step in CI.
- Risk: Incomplete audit trails for operator actions. Mitigation: enforce middleware-level event emission and end-to-end signed log export.
